modules.name: adhd_gwas_loci
modules.title: ADHD GWAS Index Loci (Demontis 2023)
modules.description: Allele-level ADHD associations at 27 published GWAS index loci.

modules.name: apoe_epsilon
modules.title: APOE type (ε2, ε3, ε4)
modules.description: Which versions of the APOE gene you carry. APOE helps carry cholesterol in the body and is the best-known gene linked with Alzheimer's disease risk later in life.

modules.name: big_five_personality_snps
modules.title: Big Five Personality SNPs
modules.description: Genome-wide-significant common variants associated with the Big Five personality dimensions (neuroticism, extraversion, openness, agreeableness, conscientiousness) and related affective traits (wellbeing, worry, loneliness, mood instability), filtered to protein-coding gene loci with biological interpretability. Curated from the GWAS Catalog (GRCh38).

modules.name: blood_groups
modules.title: Blood Groups (ABO and Rh)
modules.description: Your ABO blood group and Rh markers, read from several DNA positions.

modules.name: smell
modules.title: Body odor and sense of smell
modules.description: How your genes shape your own body odor and what you can smell.

modules.name: bodybuilding
modules.title: Bodybuilding genetics — lean mass, strength & fibre-type variants
modules.description: Common variants associated with appendicular lean mass, hand-grip strength, and muscle fibre-type composition relevant to bodybuilding and strength sports. GWAS-scale loci carry per-allele effect sizes from UK Biobank; three classic candidate genes (ACTN3, PPARGC1A, ADRB2) are expressed as categorical fibre-type and adrenergic markers. Research/informational only.

modules.name: cancer
modules.title: Cancer
modules.description: Pathogenic variants in cancer-predisposition genes — a ClinVar gene panel

modules.name: cardio
modules.title: Cardio
modules.description: Pathogenic variants in cardiac-disease genes — a ClinVar gene panel

modules.name: cognitive_intelligence
modules.title: Cognitive & Intelligence
modules.description: Curated variants with known biological mechanisms affecting cognition, memory, learning, and brain development. 32 SNPs across 31 genes, each with a mechanistic interpretation — from the APOE cluster (Alzheimer risk) to synaptic machinery (SNAP25, BSN), neurotransmitter signaling (COMT, DRD2, HTR2A), neuroplasticity (BDNF, KIBRA), and stress response (FKBP5, FOXO3). Selected from GWAS hits and candidate-gene studies for individually meaningful biological effects.

modules.name: coronary
modules.title: Coronary
modules.description: Coronary-artery-disease risk variants — 27 curated loci (Generation-I port)

modules.name: hfe_compound_het
modules.title: Iron storage gene (HFE)
modules.description: Whether you carry the two common changes in the HFE gene that are linked with hereditary haemochromatosis, where the body stores too much iron.

modules.name: aggression_anger_snps
modules.title: Irritability & Aggression — Neurobiological SNPs
modules.description: GWAS-significant common variants in genes with established neurobiological roles, associated with irritability measurement and aggressive behavior phenotypes. Filtered from the GWAS Catalog to retain only loci in or near genes with documented neural function (neurotransmission, synaptic plasticity, neural development, stress axis, brain-enriched signaling). 28 SNPs across 22 genes; 26 from Nagel et al. 2018 item-level neuroticism (irritability item, n=366,726), 1 from Mick et al. 2014 (anger proneness, n=8,747), and 1 from Tielbeek et al. 2022 BroadABC (antisocial behavior, n=85,359).

modules.name: lactose_tolerance
modules.title: Lactose Tolerance & Lactase Persistence
modules.description: MCM6/LCT lactase persistence variants affecting adult lactose digestion

modules.name: lipidmetabolism
modules.title: Lipid Metabolism
modules.description: Lipid-metabolism and cardiovascular-risk variants (Generation-I port)

modules.name: longevitymap
modules.title: Longevity Map
modules.description: Longevity-associated variants from the LongevityMap database — 528 rsIDs

modules.name: pathogenic
modules.title: Pathogenic
modules.description: Genome-wide ClinVar pathogenic / likely-pathogenic variant flag

modules.name: pharmgkb
modules.title: Pharmacogenomics
modules.description: Drug response by genotype — ClinPGx clinical annotations (evidence 1A–2B)

modules.name: placebo_response_research
modules.title: Placebo Response Genetics - Research Evidence
modules.description: Research-only genotype annotations for context-dependent placebo response findings in irritable bowel syndrome and experimental pain.

modules.name: placebo_response_claude
modules.title: Placebo Response Genetics — OPRM1, COMT and FAAH
modules.description: Genetic variants in the opioid (OPRM1), dopamine (COMT) and endocannabinoid (FAAH) pathways studied for association with placebo analgesia and placebo response — not a diagnostic test, and the evidence is mixed and interaction-heavy rather than settled.

modules.name: risk_impulsivity_snps
modules.title: Risk-Taking & Impulsivity SNPs
modules.description: Genome-wide-significant common variants in protein-coding genes associated with risk-taking behaviour, general risk tolerance, and ADHD. Curated from GWAS Catalog (GRCh38), filtered to biologically interpretable loci.

modules.name: fut2_secretor
modules.title: Secretor status (FUT2)
modules.description: Whether your saliva and other body fluids carry your blood group sugars, which depends on the FUT2 gene.

modules.name: superhuman
modules.title: Superhuman
modules.description: Curated protective / beneficial-trait alleles across 37 genes, all PMID-grounded

modules.name: thrombophilia
modules.title: Thrombophilia
modules.description: Inherited blood-clotting risk: Factor V Leiden, prothrombin and related loci
